# herdsman message

<!-- Generated by make docs. Change the source it names and regenerate. -->

The adjutant message channel: message status|wait|read|release|ack|send|hold|unhold, and register|courier|card-watch|resume-goal|authority|leak-gate.

## herdsman message ack

```text
usage: herdsman message [--json] ack <claim> <id> <record>
  acknowledge a claimed message after durable intake

settings: HERDSMAN_NAME and HERDSMAN_INBOX are required.
SWEEP, ALERT_AFTER, RUN_FOR, INTERVAL, RECHECK, DEADLINE, HEALTH_AFTER and EVENT_READ_MAX are
durations (seconds, or with an s, m, h or d suffix; blanks around it allowed; clamped to each
command's range); LOCK_WAIT is a whole number from 1 to 60. A bad or missing value is one line
naming it, exit 2, before anything runs.

exit codes:
  0  done
  2  usage, an invalid or missing setting, or a refusal (the reason on stderr)
```

## herdsman message authority

```text

  RELAY or HUMAN (--json: {"type":"authority","status":"relay|human","text"})

settings: HERDSMAN_INBOX is required.
SWEEP, ALERT_AFTER, RUN_FOR, INTERVAL, RECHECK, DEADLINE, HEALTH_AFTER and EVENT_READ_MAX are
durations (seconds, or with an s, m, h or d suffix; blanks around it allowed; clamped to each
command's range); LOCK_WAIT is a whole number from 1 to 60. A bad or missing value is one line
naming it, exit 2, before anything runs.

exit codes:
  0  done (RELAY)
  2  usage, an invalid or missing setting, or a refusal (the reason on stderr)
  3  HUMAN
```

## herdsman message leak-gate

```text
usage: herdsman message [--json] leak-gate <file> [heading...]
  LEAK_ALLOW_FILE LEAK_PATTERN

settings: LEAK_PATTERN (an added pattern) and LEAK_ALLOW_FILE (exact lines allowed) are optional; no inbox is needed.

exit codes:
  0  done (clean)
  1  a leak or a missing section
  2  usage, an invalid or missing setting, or a refusal (the reason on stderr)
```

## herdsman message wait

```text
usage: herdsman message [--json] wait
  wait for a message or a health change (--json: one event object)

settings: HERDSMAN_NAME and HERDSMAN_INBOX are required.
SWEEP, ALERT_AFTER, RUN_FOR, INTERVAL, RECHECK, DEADLINE, HEALTH_AFTER and EVENT_READ_MAX are
durations (seconds, or with an s, m, h or d suffix; blanks around it allowed; clamped to each
command's range); LOCK_WAIT is a whole number from 1 to 60. A bad or missing value is one line
naming it, exit 2, before anything runs.

exit codes:
  0  done (a message or TICK)
  1  HEALTH
  2  usage, an invalid or missing setting, or a refusal (the reason on stderr)
```
